info.user_prompt: I am building a lightweight L2ctions: lane departure warning, forward collision warning, adaptive cruise assist, and blind spot detection. Dual camera setup from video files. Front camera needs lane detection AND vehicle detection running together. Rear camera needs vehicle detection for blind spot monitoring. Prioritize the lightest and fastest models available since this must run real-time on edge hardware. Live display, and also write all detections to a JSON file.

pipeline_requirements.user_intent_summary: Lightweight real-time Edge AI vision pipeline for ADAS-like L2 functions using dual video-file cameras, with only vehicle detection and depth estimation.

extras.application: ADAS L2-style functions (forward collision warning, adaptive cruise assist, blind spot detection) driven by vehicle detection and monocular depth on front and rear cameras. Lane departure logic removed.
extras.notes: Front and rear cameras run vehicle detection and depth estimation. All inference engines FP16 where applicable. FCW/BSD/ACC logic computed externally in C++ using the JSON outputs.

nodes.name: Frame Input
nodes.short_description: Receives a single video/image frame from upstream as a BGR uint8 OpenCV-style array (H,W,3); original H,W saved for later box rescaling in yolov8/YOLOv8.py.

nodes.name: Color & Resize
nodes.short_description: Converts BGR->RGB with cv2.cvtColor and directly resizes to the ONNX input spatial size (self.input_width,self.input_height) using cv2.resize (no letterbox/pad, per README).

nodes.name: Normalize & Tensorize
nodes.short_description: Scales pixels to [0,1] by dividing by 255.0, transposes HWC->CHW, adds batch dim to NCHW, and casts to float32 to form (1,3,H_in,W_in) input tensor.

nodes.name: YOLOv8 ONNX Inference
nodes.short_description: Runs models/yolov8m.onnx via onnxruntime.InferenceSession.run(output_names, {input_name: input_tensor}) to produce raw detection predictions.

nodes.name: Decode & Score Filter
nodes.short_description: Squeezes output[0] then transposes to per-candidate rows (np.squeeze(...).T), computes per-row class score as max(pred[:,4:]), and filters candidates by conf_thres (default 0.7).

nodes.name: Box Rescale Convert
nodes.short_description: Takes boxes as xywh from pred[:,:4], normalizes by [W_in,H_in,W_in,H_in], rescales to original image [W,H,W,H], then converts xywh->xyxy via yolov8.utils.xywh2xyxy.

nodes.name: Multiclass NMS
nodes.short_description: Computes class_ids as argmax(pred[:,4:]) and applies yolov8.utils.multiclass_nms(boxes,scores,class_ids,iou_thres default 0.5) to return selected boxes,scores,class_ids.

nodes.name: Detection Output
nodes.short_description: Outputs this repo’s inference result as (boxes_xyxy, scores, class_ids) arrays/lists in original-image pixel coordinates for downstream vehicle-detection use (optional rendering via draw_detections exists but is not required).
